body.name: Monotone Lipschitz envelopes
body.construction: For \(a\neq a_0\), define \(\ell_{xa}(t;y)=\max(\{0\}\cup\{y_{cx}-\Gamma(m_c-t)_+:c\in T_{xa}(S)\})\) and \(u_{xa}(t;y)=\min(\{1\}\cup\{y_{cx}+\Gamma(t-m_c)_+:c\in T_{xa}(S)\})\) with \(z_+=\max\{z,0\}\); for \(a=a_0\), use the same formulas with \(\Gamma=0\).
